what: light-change discriminator removed a real cut (115.415 s, hall -> interview; Q 0.961). Low within-shot structure similarity in dark frames inflates Q = S_x / max(S_w, 0.05). Held-out controls (v1 cuts, synthetic exposure steps) did not cover dark-to-bright real cuts
effect: some true cuts missing from v3; R4-rec may penalise
fix: add real dark-scene cuts to controls; use an absolute S_x bound alongside the ratio; pre-register before use

what: near-black detector does not apply the light-change test; lamp pulses in the dark installation passages (e.g. 654.65 s) can be detected as cuts; 699.50 s ambiguous
effect: possible false near-black cuts (48 of 53 inside v1 BLACK intervals)
fix: apply a dark-adapted light-change test (static-structure mask) before accepting near-black cuts

what: dissolve detector passed synthetic held-out controls but fires on talking heads moving against plain backgrounds (919-1000 s talk; e.g. 942-944 s)
effect: false DISSOLVE segments split long talk shots (80.9 s -> pieces)
fix: add real moving-speaker negatives; require global structure change (both end frames' background edges differ), pre-register before use

what: jump-cut detector failed held-out validation (synthetic recall 9/60): edge-structure change between two moments of the same static shot is small, and the (a) light test also suppresses same-framing changes
effect: low-contrast jump cuts remain undetected (F-30 unresolved)
fix: face/body-region displacement or feature-track discontinuity; pre-register
